items.title: 1 Value Stock with Impressive Fundamentals and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Value stocks typically trade at discounts to the broader market, offering patient investors the opportunity to buy businesses when they’re out of favor. The key risk, however, is that these stocks are usually cheap for a reason, and a low valuation can reflect underlying business challenges rather than a genuine bargain.

items.title: The Fall and Redemption of Bill Miller, the Greatest Money Manager of Our Time
items.summary: He was known as one of the world’s best investors, until he got smacked down by the financial crisis. But almost 20 years later, his ideas and legacy resonate strongly.

items.title: What Does American International Group (AIG) Gain From Its Cloud Outage Cover?
items.summary: American International Group (NYSE:AIG) introduced a parametric cloud outage cyber insurance solution for US clients, developed with Parametrix. The product focuses on business interruption risks linked to outages at third party cloud and software service providers. Claims are based on predefined outage triggers and external monitoring data, which is intended to support a faster claims process. items.title: Can AIG Turn Rising Cloud Risks Into Cyber Insurance Growth?
items.summary: American International Group is expanding cyber coverage for cloud outages, using real-time monitoring to speed payments and tap rising demand for cloud risk protection.

items.title: The Floor Under PAAS Stock Is Being Tested Again
items.summary: A silver and gold miner has fallen back to a price floor that has repeatedly launched powerful rallies, but this time it arrives with far bigger promises to keep.

items.title: AIG Q2 Deep Dive: Selective Growth and Strategic Discipline Define Outlook
items.summary: Global insurance giant AIG (NYSE:AIG) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026 as sales rose 3.9% year on year to $7.11 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2 per share was 3.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: AIG CEO on Earnings, Shipping in Hormuz, AI Buildout
items.summary: American International Group Inc. Chief Executive Officer Eric Andersen talks about how geopolitical risk is providing great opportunities to the insurer. He also speaks about clients that need to travel through the Strait of Hormuz, earnings, the ai buildout and how they use artificial intelligence. He speaks to Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick.
